title: Nvidia and PulteGroup are helping this startup put mini data centers on homes
raw_text:
Key Points
- Span, a California-based startup, has developed small, fractional data centers, or "nodes," called XFRA units.
- The idea is to take advantage of unused electrical capacity on local grids, which the Span smart panels can pinpoint.
- Nvidia GPUs are powering the units, and PulteGroup is testing the systems.
